MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "I Dreamed A Dream feels like a natural next choice because expressive singing and musical-theatre material connect with my interest in Stages and A Musical Affair.",
    "Duets and Together could fit my interest in vocal performances, while Nostalgia suggests familiar songs I might enjoy; these are possibilities rather than definite choices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas releases miss my current mood: enjoying Christmas At Downton Abbey does not mean I want more holiday music now, even when it includes appealing voices or orchestration.",
    "To All The Girls... does not give me a strong enough connection to the orchestral or expressive vocal music I want right now; my interest in country music is selective.",
    "Titles such as Duets and Together leave me unsure whether the performers and songs actually match my tastes, so their apparent relevance is not enough for me to choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing preference, making too many suggestions depend on a seasonal interest I am not pursuing now.",
    "Broad connections to vocal music seem to count too heavily when the particular performers, repertoire and emotional character are what would make me choose an album."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent listening to The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe suggests an interest in calming classical music that I do not see strongly reflected here.",
    "Stages and A Musical Affair point toward expressive singing and musical-theatre songs, which explain my interest in I Dreamed A Dream more directly than a general interest in vocal albums."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly understand my interest in expressive vocals but give too much weight to past holiday listening and too little to my current interest in calming classical music and musical-theatre performances."
}
